title: Neural variational Skyrmions as a topological benchmark: emergent symmetry, precision energies and KAN--MLP comparison
abstract: arXiv:2611.27411v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose the three-dimensional Skyrme model as a topological benchmark for neural variational methods and construct fully three-dimensional Skyrmions with baryon number $B=1,\ldots,4$ without imposing a symmetry ansatz, with high precision. For $B=2,3,4$, the relaxation of these Skyrmions starts from $B$ unit-charge lumps with random positions and orientations, which carry no symmetry information. The known toroidal, tetrahedral, and cubic Skyrmions nevertheless emerge spontaneously. The resulting variational energies for $B=1,\ldots,4$ lie slightly below the published reference values. The neural method highlights the high accuracy for retaining the topological charge, differing from $B$ by at most $10^{-6}$ in the highest-precision solutions. translated_title: 神经变分Skyrmion作为拓扑基准：涌现对称性、高精度能量与KAN–MLP对比
translated_abstract: 我们提出将三维Skyrme模型作为神经变分方法的拓扑基准，并在不施加对称性拟设的条件下，以高精度构建了重子数 $B=1,\ldots,4$ 的完全三维Skyrmion。对于 $B=2,3,4$，这些Skyrmion的弛豫过程从位置和取向随机、不携带任何对称性信息的 $B$ 个单位电荷团块出发。然而，已知的环面形、四面体和立方体Skyrmion却自发涌现。所得的 $B=1,\ldots,4$ 变分能量略低于已发表的参考值。该神经方法凸显了在保持拓扑荷方面的高精度，在最高精度的解中拓扑荷与 $B$ 的偏差不超过 $10^{-6}$。我们的数值方法通过了诸如Derrick位力关系和Faddeev–Bogomolny界等物理约束检验，并通过独立的准随机初始构型等方式进行了评估与验证。
tldr: 该论文将三维Skyrme模型确立为神经变分方法的拓扑基准：在无对称性拟设条件下高精度构建了 $B=1$ 至 $4$ 的Skyrmion，已知对称结构自发涌现，能量略低于文献参考值，拓扑荷保持精度达 $10^{-6}$，并通过Derrick位力关系与Faddeev–Bogomolny界等物理约束检验，同时对比了KAN与MLP网络的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the 3D Skyrme model as a topological benchmark for neural variational methods, constructing high-precision Skyrmions (B=1–4) without symmetry ansätze—known symmetric configurations emerge spontaneously, energies fall slightly below reference values, topological charge is conserved to 10^-6, physical constraint tests are passed, and KAN and MLP architectures are compared.
